title: Model Backends & ML Operations
summary: This module manages the core machine learning operations, including tensor manipulations, neural network layers, and the Key-Value cache for efficient model state. It orchestrates the end-to-end text generation pipeline, from input processing to output production.

nodes.label: Input Prompts
nodes.title: Input Prompts
nodes.description: Raw text or token sequences provided by the user or application to initiate text generation.

nodes.label: Handle Tokenization
nodes.title: Tokenizer
nodes.description: Converts raw text inputs into numerical tokens for model processing and transforms generated tokens back into human-readable text.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Text Generation
nodes.title: Text Generation Pipeline
nodes.description: Manages the end-to-end process of generating text, including prefill, decoding, KV cache interactions, and sampling, potentially using DFlash optimization.

nodes.label: Manage KV Cache State
nodes.title: KV Cache Management
nodes.description: Handles the Key-Value cache for efficient model state management during text generation, supporting features like snapshots, branching, and eviction policies.

nodes.label: Perform Tensor Operations
nodes.title: Tensor Operations (GGML/MLX)
nodes.description: Executes fundamental tensor manipulations such as permutations, slicing, chunking, and matrix multiplication, forming the core of the ML backend.

nodes.label: Apply Neural Network Layers
nodes.title: Neural Network Layers
nodes.description: Implements and applies various neural network layers, including pooling operations, as part of the model's forward pass.

nodes.label: MLX/GGML Runtime
nodes.title: MLX/GGML Runtime
nodes.description: The underlying machine learning runtime environment (e.g., MLX for Apple Silicon, GGML for CPU) that executes tensor operations.

nodes.label: Process Model Files
nodes.title: Model File Processing
nodes.description: Identifies, parses, and loads various model file formats (e.g., Safetensors, PyTorch, GGUF) to prepare models for runtime.

nodes.label: Model Assets
nodes.title: Model Assets
nodes.description: External files containing model weights, configurations, and tokenizer data, used for loading and initializing models.

nodes.label: Generated Text Output
nodes.title: Generated Text Output
nodes.description: The final human-readable text generated by the model after processing and decoding.

groups.label: Generative Flow
groups.title: Generative Flow
groups.description: Components involved in the end-to-end process of generating text from user input.

groups.label: Model Runtime Core
groups.title: Model Runtime Core
groups.description: The fundamental machine learning operations and underlying runtime environment for executing model computations.

groups.label: Model State Management
groups.title: Model State Management
groups.description: Components responsible for managing the model's internal state, particularly the Key-Value cache for efficient sequence generation.

groups.label: Model Preparation
groups.title: Model Preparation
groups.description: Handles the identification, parsing, and loading of model assets to make them ready for use by the generation pipeline.
